items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Last night we met Earl, he was her lawyer for the last three years.

ctx.x: He was a Mexican Hairless or some damn thing. He was a little piece of shit that you could stick in a pinhole. But he was Pepe!

I was lucky, I think. I wasn't working with her when she was all strung out and all ...[VOLUME BRIEFLY DROPS DRAMATICALLY, TO INAUDIBILITY]... I was lucky.
